title: Ladnier's Rosicrucian withdrawal from music
summary: Marge says Ladnier tried to explain Rosicrucianism to them on Seventh Avenue and wanted to be alone, stopped caring about his appearance and family, and one of his last jobs was the Panassie date.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: We went by that place and I told him ( unintelligible ) and he followed us across the street because he stood on 7th Avenue, he was trying to explain this Rosicrucionist to Zutty and I, what it meant and all that.
Well what is it actually? It's a sort of Christian thing isn't it?
Yes, meditation and all of that. And I never understood it, but he did. He was studying it. He really believed in it. But it was this belief that he had that he wanted to be alone, and all.
Get out of the music business?
Yes. I think that's what it

was. He didn't care any more. For his parents or anything you know? Because he got so he didn't fix himself up. Didn't dress or anything any more. I guess about one of the last things Tommy did must have been those recordings with Pandssie. AM
